name: Axis Solutions Limited
summary: Axis Solutions Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of engineering products for oil and gas, refinery, cement, and water pollution equipment industries in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Automation and Digitalisation, Water, and Industrial Engineering & Systems. The company also offers analyzer shelters, steam and water analysis systems, gas analysis system control panels, and automation system products; complex measurement and analytical technology; automation, control, communication, IIOT products and systems; and industrial automation, instrumentation, and control system products and solutions for oil and gas, petrochemical, refinery, telecom, cement,…
